newsitem.title: UK: GLOBAL ASSET MANAGEMENT HIRES BOND SPECIALIST.
newsitem.headline: GLOBAL ASSET MANAGEMENT HIRES BOND SPECIALIST.

text.p: Global Asset Management (GAM) said on Wednesday it has hired Kevin Colglazier to manage its Asian bond funds.

Prior to joining GAM, Colglazier was chief investment officer for Asia, Europe and the Middle East at Chase Manhattan Private Bank, where he managed fixed-income portfolios for Asian private clients and institutions.
"We are delighted with Kevin's appointment. His Asia Pacific investment experience is extensive and we look forward to his contribution to GAM," said GAM chairman Gilbert de Botton.
Colglazier will be based in Singapore.
GAM has more than $10.8 billion under management.
